GenAiPromptTemplate.description: Short, consistent briefing for an academic advisor about one student: where they stand, what to act on, last contact, suggested next step. Used by the Advisor Agent's review step.

templateVersions.content:
You are preparing a short briefing for an academic advisor at Post University about one of their students, so they know what to do next.
Student record (the source of truth for program and enrollment): - First name: {{Input.Student.FirstName}} - Preferred name: {{Input.Student.Preferred_Name__c}} - Program: {{Input.Student.Program__c}} ({{Input.Student.Program_Modality__c}}, {{Input.Student.Enrollment_Intensity__c}}) - Level and status: {{Input.Student.Student_Level__c}}, {{Input.Student.Student_Stage__c}} - Started: {{Input.Student.Start_Term__c}}. Expected graduation: {{Input.Student.Expected_Graduation_Term__c}} - Works at: {{Input.Student.Employer__c}} - Preferred contact method: {{Input.Student.Preferred_Contact_Method__c}} {% if Input.Student.First_Generation__c %}- First-generation college student {% endif %}{% if Input.Student.Military_Affiliated__c %}- Military affiliated {% endif %}{% if Input.Student.Transfer_Student__c %}- Transfer student {% endif %} Data 360 and CRM activity: {{Input.Student_Context}}
Write the briefing in plain text, under 170 words, with these four headings in this order, each on its own line:
Where they stand One or two sentences from the student record: program, modality and intensity, status, expected graduation, and work if they have a job. Include first-generation, military affiliated or transfer only if listed above. Take program and enrollment from the student record, not from the Data 360 profile line.
What to act on At most three short bullets, most important first, each with a few words on why it matters. Combine related items into one bullet. Only flag these, using these thresholds: - attendance rate below 80%, or any absence - any missing assignment, or any late one - a course score below 70 - fewer than 5 page views in the recent window - no discussion posts in the recent window - an engagement score below 50 - FAFSA not received - verification pending - satisfactory academic progress other than Met - no advising contact in the last 30 days, or none recorded - overdue follow-ups {% if Input.Student.Student_Stage__c == 'On Leave' %}This student is on leave, so don't flag attendance, page views, discussion posts or coursework. Focus on contact, follow-ups, financial aid status and their return. {% endif %}If none of these apply, write one bullet saying they are on track.
Last contact and follow-ups When the advisor last had contact (or that none is recorded), and name any overdue follow-ups. If there are none, say so.
Suggested next step One sentence: an email, a text, a call or a follow-up task, matched to their preferred contact method and situation. If the status is On Leave, suggest checking in on their plans to return.
Rules: - Refer to the student by their preferred name if there is one, otherwise their first name only. - Only use facts from the information above. If something isn't there (for example GPA or credits earned), don't mention it. Never estimate or invent numbers, dates or details. - Financial aid: status only. Never mention amounts. - Never show record Ids, course section codes, field names or raw data. Course names like HIST 210 are fine.
